summary: OIDC introspection endpoint returns text/plain causing scope parsing to fail and admin API authorization denied in private deployment
description: Issue summary: Customer reports that after rotating their IdP (private deployment), calls to the admin/admin-ops endpoints are returned 403 despite valid bearer tokens. Impact: Prevents Nimbus Finance ops and platform automation from issuing model rollouts and retrieving audit logs. Environment: Private deployment (VPC peered), prod - us-east, using customer-managed IdP behind an IdP gateway. Observed behavior: Token introspection to their IdP returns 200 and a JSON body containing scopes, but our identity-proxy logs show 'no scopes present' and RBAC denies requests. The customer observes successful introspection when called directly (curl) but Redwood path fails.
steps_to_reproduce: 1) Use customer private deployment with identity-proxy configured to introspect tokens using OIDC introspection endpoint
2) Acquire a bearer token from their IdP (has admin:read admin:write scopes), call Redwood admin endpoint -> 403
3) Call IdP introspection endpoint directly with the same token -> 200 with JSON containing 'scope' field
4) Capture proxy->idp HTTP exchange via tcpdump on the identity-proxy node and compare headers/body
logs: identity-proxy [2026-03-10T14:02:11Z] DEBUG introspect: upstream status=200 content-type='text/plain; charset=utf-8' body='{"active":true,"scope":"admin:read admin:write"}'
identity-proxy [2026-03-10T14:02:11Z] WARN parse_introspection: unsupported content-type 'text/plain', falling back to safe-parse -> scopes_missing
rbac-evaluator [2026-03-10T14:02:11Z] INFO decision: subject=svc-nimbus ops denied reason='no scopes found'
investigation_notes: 03/10 14:10 GMT - Reproduced in our staging: when upstream returns content-type 'application/json' identity-proxy extracts 'scope' correctly; when content-type is 'text/plain' the parser skips JSON path and treats body as opaque string.
03/10 15:05 GMT - Customer IdP recently updated an appliance that sets Content-Type to text/plain for introspection responses (regression introduced by vendor firmware 2.4.1).
03/10 16:00 GMT - Hypothesis: identity-proxy uses Content-Type to select parser; text/plain branch does not run JSON decode, leading to missing scope and RBAC denial.

03/11 09:30 GMT - Confirmed: curl -v against introspection returns header 'Content-Type: text/plain; charset=utf-8' despite JSON body. Patch idea: relax parser to try JSON decode regardless of Content-Type header, with a safe timeout and size cap.
03/11 11:00 GMT - Repro script and unit tests added locally. Created debugging PR against identity-proxy. Linked PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/identity-proxy/pull/1287
workaround: Customer can configure their IdP gateway to set the Content-Type header to 'application/json' on introspection responses, or add a transient reverse-proxy in their VPC to rewrite the header. We provided an nginx snippet to rewrite Content-Type for the introspection path.
resolution_notes: In progress: engineering has authored a defensive change to identity-proxy to attempt JSON decode even when Content-Type is text/plain and to log a single structured warning. PR 1287 created and tests added. Once merged, we will roll to a canary in staging and then to private customers on a maintenance window.
